prompt: Our invoices come out a cent or two off on orders with discounted lines. Each line price lives in src/price.mjs (it applies the line's discount) and the order total lives in src/invoice.mjs (it sums the lines). The two disagree about where rounding happens, so totals drift. Settle on one consistent rounding rule across both files: round each line to whole cents, then report the exact sum of those rounded lines. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix.
